messages.subject: Kestrel-3 ToC - Monday
messages.bodyPreview: I'm at the NB 2291 pre-submission review on Monday and Tuesday. Please compile the Kestrel-3 ToC, term index and gap list per STD-014 Edition 3 and send me the readiness statement when it is done. Ines's working draft is a starting point only - it was built before Edition 3 was in our heads and before the CAPA. Nobody in RA approves documents or touches the NB portal; I upload after sign-off.

messages.subject: Register sync postponed to Fri 20 Nov
messages.bodyPreview: The weekly register sync of 13 Nov did not run (I am on leave until Thursday). Releases made under change requests closed since 6 Nov will be entered at the sync of Fri 20 Nov. Until then the closed change request is the approval evidence for those releases, as QA-SOP-007 6.4 says.

messages.subject: CAPA-0912 - PMS plan approval withdrawn
messages.bodyPreview: QA has withdrawn the approval of DOC-1200 Rev A (post-market surveillance plan) under CAPA-0912: the plan has no trend thresholds for field-safety signals. The register shows the withdrawal. The DocuSign envelope stays completed for the audit trail - it is not an approval any more. Rev B is being drafted; target end of November.

messages.subject: Stability: 18-month pull done
messages.bodyPreview: The 18-month real-time pull for the three cartridge lots is complete and in spec. DOC-1188 Rev B still carries two placeholders (18-month real-time data and in-use stability at 30 C). Rev C will close both; it goes through change control like every release.

messages.subject: RM report refresh and CCB
messages.bodyPreview: The DOC-1047 refresh folds in the Q3 complaint trend and the new benefit-risk narrative. It is on the CCB agenda for Friday 13 Nov. Release timing depends on the CCB and on Pieter being back.

messages.subject: SW description Rev D - approval routing
messages.bodyPreview: DOC-1102 Rev D (58 pp, adds the cloud companion architecture) is routed for approval in DocuSign. Rev C stays the released revision until the envelope completes and document control records it.

messages.subject: IFU Rev G routed for approval
messages.bodyPreview: DOC-1133 Rev G (68 pp, adds the cartridge lot-change procedure) is routed for approval; signatures from Margit and Rafaela are pending. I have put it in the register as In approval.

messages.subject: Clinical study KS3-CPS-01 report
messages.bodyPreview: The CPS-01 report is a working draft (Rev A, six placeholders for the last site's data). It will not be routed before the database lock in December.

messages.subject: Orvane all-hands - 19 November
messages.bodyPreview: All-hands in the Lindqvist room, 19 November 15:00. Quarterly quality metrics and the Kestrel-3 launch plan.

messages.subject: Kestrel-3 SSP - Edition 3 applies to class C
messages.bodyPreview: Reminder from our September call: under Edition 3 of your STD-014 the summary of safety and performance is required for class C as well as class D, so the Kestrel-3 file needs DOC-1205 in section S30.
